results.text: Competitive inhibition of renal tubular secretion of gemifloxacin by probenecid. Probenecid interacts with transport processes of drugs at several sites in the body. For most quinolones, renal clearance is reduced by concomitant administration of probenecid. The interaction between gemifloxacin and probenecid has not yet been studied.
